title: PM: No RCI to review govt response to recent flood disaster | The Star
text: PM: No RCI to review govt response to recent flood disaster | The Star × View Nation PM: No RCI to review govt response to recent flood disaster By RAHMAH GHAZALI Monday, 16 Mar 2015 | 11:08 AM MYT share bookmark Related Stories World 13h ago Norway parliament probes Epstein links to politicians, diplomats World 22h ago Zimbabwean president opens parliament session, pledges to strengthen macroeconomic stability Metro News 28 Sep 2026 Parliament open day draws 13,000 KUALA LUMPUR: The Government does not intend to set up a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI) to review its weaknesses and shortcomings in dealing with the recent flood disaster, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Najib Tun Razak (pic) said Monday. Responding to Datuk Seri Azalina Othman (BN-Pengerang), Najib said setting up an RCI was not a necessity as there were already ongoing efforts by the Government to mitigate the floods.
